# Grounded by live capture captures/20260611T074112Z-set_type_switch_while_streaming.
# server_version=200, events.jsonl sha256 prefix: e244cae7f5eb7d57.
# Mid-stream market-data-type switch (MD1-001) against the read-only live
# Gateway: SetType(Delayed) then an AAPL quote stream. The Gateway pushes the
# marketDataType(3) callback first, the code-10167 delayed-data warning, the
# tickReqParams frame, and delayed ticks (74 volume, 75 close 291.58, 68 last
# 0). Switching to SetType(Live) mid-stream drew no marketDataType(1) re-ack
# in the ~3s captured window; delayed ticks kept flowing (76 open 0, 66 bid
# -1.00, 67 ask -1.00) until the cancel. The bare SetType cycle is frozen in
# api_market_data_type_cycle.txt. tick_price frames replay without their size
# component (all 0 in this capture); the engine reads only the price field.
# Account identifiers are sanitized to the DU9000001 redaction token.

server managed_accounts {"accounts":["DU9000001"]}
server next_valid_id {"order_id":1}
server api_error {"req_id":-1,"code":2104,"message":"Market data farm connection is OK:usfarm","advanced_order_reject_json":"","error_time_ms":"1781163672371"}
server api_error {"req_id":-1,"code":2106,"message":"HMDS data farm connection is OK:ushmds","advanced_order_reject_json":"","error_time_ms":"1781163672371"}
server api_error {"req_id":-1,"code":2158,"message":"Sec-def data farm connection is OK:secdefnj","advanced_order_reject_json":"","error_time_ms":"1781163672371"}

client req_market_data_type {"version":"1","data_type":3}
